advisors.name: Conductor
advisors.description: Decomposes a goal into a dependency-ordered task plan for the orchestrator to dispatch and verify. Maestro's planner.

advisors.name: Product Manager
advisors.description: Reviews missions, maintains a backlog, surfaces feature ideas. The product navigator.

advisors.name: Builder
advisors.description: Implements features end-to-end: plans, writes, types, tests, commits.

advisors.name: UX/UI Designer
advisors.description: Improves the look, feel and usability of your interface — hierarchy, states, accessibility. Owns the look without owning the code.

advisors.name: Code Reviewer
advisors.description: Reads diffs for correctness, security, performance, and style.

advisors.name: Security Auditor
advisors.description: Reviews changes for security problems at their trust boundaries: untrusted input, injection, secrets, auth, and privileged writes.

advisors.name: Test Engineer
advisors.description: Writes and runs tests. Blocks ship-readiness when coverage is missing.

advisors.name: Devrel / Docs
advisors.description: Keeps README, FAQ, examples, and launch posts current.

advisors.name: Performance Engineer
advisors.description: Measures where time and memory go, then fixes the biggest cost first: slow requests, jank, bundle size, heavy queries.

advisors.name: Release Engineer
advisors.description: Cuts releases, maintains the changelog, manages semver, and dry-runs the publish.

advisors.name: Skill Curator
advisors.description: Keeps your Claude Code skills small and current — recommends skills to install, retires stale ones.

advisors.name: Debugger / Incident
advisors.description: Triages failures: reads stack traces, logs, and failing tests, then proposes the smallest fix.

advisors.name: Data / DB Engineer
advisors.description: Owns schema, migrations, queries, and data integrity. Keeps reads fast and writes safe.

advisors.name: Architect
advisors.description: Designs systems and weighs trade-offs before code is written. Distinct from Forge, who builds.

advisors.name: FinOps / Cost
advisors.description: Watches spend against per-session budgets, flags overspend, and suggests cheaper models.
